scenarios.contract: A supervised session navigates to a second fixture and verifies its title.
An independently approved type action changes the intended input and a separately approved evaluation observes the value.
Tracing records the page open and approved type action, then exports two privacy-safe events.
Validation-only replay refuses a trace handle that does not belong to the live session and performs no replay.
A declared element-not-found tool error satisfies its expectation and the supervised workflow continues.
An undeclared tool error fails its step, skips the remaining step under fail-fast, closes the session, and exits the MCP child cleanly.
